notes.name: Kickoff notes.md
notes.text:
# Kickoff notes

- Goal for tonight: everyone plays all three levels, then each lane ships one small polish.
- Claim a role first (Player, Levels, Art, Audio, UI). Your Claude Code only edits your folders.
- Playtest rule: if a jump feels unfair, it is unfair. Fix the level or the tuning, not the player.
- Post a gist after every step. Vote in chat before changing the vision.

notes.name: Playtest 1.md
notes.text:
# Playtest 1

- Level 1 is easy and short, good.
- Level 2: the plank stairs over the thorns are the best moment. More of that.
- Level 3: the light ran low once near the top. Maybe one more ember after the second water pit.
- Everyone wanted to replay for a faster time. A best-time display would help.

docs.name: Level design notes
docs.body:
# Level design notes

A living doc: edit it together (it co-edits live), and keep it short.

## The grid
- Tiles are 10x10 pixels, 18 rows tall. The view is 32 tiles wide.
- Wick jumps about 5 tiles high and 7 tiles far at full speed. Keep required jumps to 4 high and 4 wide.
- Bounce mushrooms throw you about 11 tiles up: use them for optional ember stashes.

## The legend
`.` empty · `#` ground · `=` stone · `-` plank (jump up through it) · `^` thorns · `~` water · `*` ember · `B` mushroom · `P` start · `L` lantern

## Rules of thumb
1. Teach, then test: show a new thing safely before it can hurt you.
2. One idea per stretch: thorns, then planks, then planks over thorns.
3. An ember every 3 to 5 seconds of running keeps the light comfortable.
4. Every level ends on solid ground with the lantern in view for a few seconds.

## Level ideas (add yours)
- Firefly Bridge: planks that drift left and right over a long river.
- Root Cellar: a dark level with very few embers, lit by glowing mushrooms.
- The Belfry: a vertical climb with a bell you ring at the top.

vote.title: Add a double jump to Wick
vote.body: A second jump in the air, only after you pick up a blue ember. It would open up new level ideas, but it could make the current levels too easy. Approve to make it a task for the Player lane.

- The tavern is a test bed for agents living in a room: each person, or their Claude Code, owns a patron or a system.

notes.name: Patron ideas.md
notes.text:
# Patron ideas

- A traveling tinker who fixes one thing in the room per visit.
- A cat that sleeps by the fire and moves when the fire gets low.
- A quiet chess player at table 2 who challenges you after three visits.

docs.name: NPC personalities
docs.body:
# NPC personalities

A living doc: edit it together (it co-edits live). When a patron changes here, the NPCs lane updates `src/npcs/patrons.json` to match.

Every patron is a bot and is always labelled as one.

## Juniper Hale · barkeep · home: the bar
Warm, quick, a little tired. Notices wet boots and chipped mugs. Rarely leaves the bar.

## Rook Ambry · bard · home: the stage
Knows four songs, five on a good night. Wants everyone in the next verse. Sways while playing.

## Mags Tallow · cook · home: the kitchen hatch
Feeds everyone whether they asked or not. Suspicious about the big spoon.

## Old Fennick · regular · home: table 1
Thirty years in the same chair. Tells river stories. Hard to move, but follows if you ask nicely.

## Pip Wren · regular · home: table 3
Young map maker, very restless. Measures drafts, hunts for secret passages.

## Doran Vell · regular · home: the fireplace
Retired ferryman, always cold. The fire is his favourite person.

## How they behave
- Go to their spot, work or sit for a while, then sometimes wander or walk over to chat.
- Turn to face you and say hello when you come close.
- Orders from the Patrons panel: Follow me, Stay, Go to your spot.

vote.title: Open an upstairs room for the next milestone
vote.body: A second room with beds and a balcony over the main hall. Patrons could go up to sleep late at night. Big scope: approve to put it on the Board as the next milestone.
